name: SpotlightCard-TS-TW
title: Spotlight Card
description: A pair of rounded dark cards that stay flat until the pointer moves over them, then a colourless or tinted radial glow follows the cursor across the surface and fades when it leaves.
use: You want a dark feature or pricing card that rewards a hover with a subtle moving light, without extra assets.
avoid: The light is pointer-only, so touch gets a flat card, and the effect barely shows on light backgrounds.
a11y: The spotlight is pointer-only and the card cannot take focus, so keyboard and touch users never trigger it. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rounded charcoal cards sit side by side on a black stage, each with a thin lighter border. Inside, a bold white heading and a few lines of grey body text are aligned top-left, leaving the lower half empty. When lit, a soft circular patch of light washes one area of the card.
behaves: Moving the pointer over a card places a radial spotlight directly under it and raises its opacity; leaving fades it out over half a second. Otherwise the cards stay flat and still.
customise: Children fill the card and spotlightColor sets the glow as an rgba string; width and spacing come from your own classes. Radius, padding, border and the dark surface are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Two divs and a mouse-driven gradient; no animation loop runs while the pointer is still.
